title: Season 01: Luna Rising is live!
subtitle: The moon awaits, pilots.
body: Season 01 opens with new biomes, a custom moonstone tech tree, and the first community-built spaceport. Login bonuses are active for the next 7 days. See you on play.mooncraft.gg.

title: Hotfix 1.0.1
subtitle: Stability + balance
body: Fixed a duplication bug in the moonstone smelter, rebalanced jetpack fuel costs, and bumped Fabric loader to 0.16.5.

title: Build contest: Lunar Architecture
subtitle: Submissions open until June 1
body: Submit your best lunar base. Top 3 builds get featured on the spawn island and earn a unique cape.
